text:
alex: CI red on runtime test: TestRetryManager::test_backoff failing intermittently on ubuntu-docker. Build 4123. example failure snippet below:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 3 retries, got 1
...
TimeoutError: wait_for_event timed out after 20ms
```
jen: ack, can you paste the CI link?
alex: https://ci.internal/reports/4123 — looks timing-related, retry wake missed.
ci-bot: Build #4123 — tests failed on ubuntu-22.04 / py3.10 (job: runtime-unit)
maria: I can take this. any seed printed in the test run?
alex: nope, test doesn't emit seed currently.
sam: quick repro attempt idea: run inside docker to match CI env:
```
docker run --rm -e CI=true -v $PWD:/app -w /app python:3.10 bash -c "pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest tests/runtime/test_retry.py::TestRetryManager::test_backoff -q"
```
maria: trying a seed scan locally (looping seeds 1..100) to find repro.
jen: also try enabling strace in container, might show thread wake timing.
maria: update: reproduced consistently with RANDOM_SEED=17 in my linux container (approx 1/8 runs). uploading failing trace to gist.
alex: nice, can you attach the full log and the failing pytest -k output?
maria: uploaded: https://gist.github.com/maria/retry-fail-17
maria: hypothesis: retry cancellation races with wake timer when jitter > 0; test uses non-deterministic queue order (random.shuffle) and no seed.
jen: try setting RW_RETRY_JITTER=0 to remove jitter and see if it stabilizes.
maria: good idea — with RW_RETRY_JITTER=0 it passed 200 runs locally for seed 17. with jitter enabled it fails within a few runs.
alex: ok please open a bisect/rerun job on CI that scans seeds and records env. I'll run a bisect if we get a failing CI artifact.
maria: created branch m/repro-seed-print that prints RANDOM_SEED and retry timestamps when CI=true.
alex: pushed logs to GCS: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/4123/retry_backoff.log
kate: queued bisect job: Build 4130 (bisect job) scanning seeds 1..200, env RW_RECORD_SEED=1. ping me if you want to stop early.
sam: also adding the canonical docker command for local repro to docs:
```
docker run --rm -e RANDOM_SEED=17 -e RW_RETRY_JITTER=1 -v $(pwd):/app -w /app python:3.10 bash -lc "pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest tests/runtime/test_retry.py::TestRetryManager::test_backoff -q"
```
jen: :eyes: nice, thanks for the command.
maria: quick update after job 4130 started: saw reproducible failure on seed=83 in the first batch. saving artifact and requesting a CI bisect to narrow down code commit range.
alex: filing a bisect request and tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. thanks everyone — assigning to @maria to follow up with diagnostic PR to make retry cancellation deterministic and add seeded test harness.
maria: will do. plan: (1) deterministic cancel path with explicit ordering, (2) add seeded-run unit test, (3) add CI check scanning seeds nightly. will follow up with PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
